title: Rework CI into explicit build-phases, add dependency-stamp to stabilize cache, and modularize lint/test pipelines
author: Maya Thompson
release_notes: Introduce dependency-stamp artifact to reduce CI cache churn and improve incremental builds
Split CI into deterministic phases: prepare -> build -> test -> lint -> publish to make timeouts and flaky steps easier to isolate
Modular composite actions for lint/test to make reuse across repos simpler
Remove legacy workflows and pin action SHAs for stability
description:
Motivation: CI runs were flaky and slow due to frequent cache invalidation from transient tool updates and duplicated setup steps across jobs. This PR refactors the GitHub Actions workflows into explicit build-phases and introduces a small deterministic dependency-stamp artifact (sha256 over lockfiles and tool versions) used as the primary cache key. The goal is to reduce unnecessary cache churn, shorten cold-starts, and make CI failures easier to reason about. Summary of changes: - Add workflows/ci-phases.yml that defines four named phases (prepare, build, test, lint) and an optional publish phase invoked by release automation. - Introduce jobs/dep-stamp action that computes dependency-stamp.txt and uploads it as a short-lived artifact for downstream jobs to pick up. - Replace ad-hoc cache key logic with: cache-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ env.dep_stamp }}; where dep_stamp is read from the artifact if present. - Modularize lint and unit-test logic into .github/actions/composite/lint and .github/actions/composite/test to reduce duplication and allow local debugging. - Pin a set of core actions (setup-node, actions/cache) to specific SHAs and vendor a tiny helper (scripts/cache-utils.sh) used by multiple workflows. - Remove legacy workflows: .github/workflows/ci-old.yml and release/deprecated-publish.yml. - Add lightweight dry-run support to release automation: release-pipeline.yml supports inputs.dry_run and will skip publish step when true. Checklist: [x] Add phased CI workflow and dep-stamp job [x] Wire dep-stamp into cache keys and artifact downloads [x] Move lint/test to composite actions [x] Pin action SHAs and add vendor script [x] Run full CI and fix discovered flakes [x] Update docs/ci.md and add troubleshooting section What I tested: - Cold-cache run on macos/ubuntu (saw 35% reduction in setup+restore time on average across sample builds) - Re-run on identical lockfiles preserved cache hits across multiple PRs - Release dry-run exercised path without publishing artifacts - Local invocation of composite actions via act reproduced lint step behavior High-level commit summary: - feat(ci): add phased ci workflow and dep-stamp job - chore(ci): composite lint/test actions and vendor cache-utils - fix(test): stabilize flaky db-connection teardown in unit tests - chore(workflows): pin core action SHAs and remove deprecated workflows - docs: add ci.md and troubleshooting notes Changed files (high-level): - .github/workflows/ci-phases.yml - .github/workflows/release-pipeline.yml - .github/actions/composite/lint/action.yml - .github/actions/composite/test/action.yml - .github/actions/dep-stamp/action.yml - scripts/cache-utils.sh - docs/ci.md - tests/unit/db/test_teardown.py - (minor updates) package-lock.json, go.sum, pyproject.lock Sample small diff: "--- a/.github/workflows/ci-phases.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci-phases.yml
@@ -1,6 +1,16 @@
 name: CI Phases
+on:
+  pull_request:
+  push:
+    branches: [ main ]
 jobs:
+  prepare:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v3
+      - name: Compute dep stamp
+        uses: ./.github/actions/dep-stamp
+      - name: Upload dep-stamp
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
+        with:
+          name: dep-stamp
+          path: dependency-stamp.txt

Note: the full workflow contains additional matrices and conditional publishes.
commit_summaries: chore(workflows): pin action SHAs and remove legacy workflows
discussion: Arjun: Can you explain how dep-stamp handles env-based tool versions (e.g., local toolchains)? Maya: dep-stamp hashes lockfiles and explicit tool versions defined in .tool-versions and package-lock/pyproject.lock; for ad-hoc envs we fallback to recording 'env:unknown' so cache miss is conservative. Lena: Please add a note in docs/ci.md about cache invalidation when bumping GH action SHAs. Maya: added docs and pinned SHAs to minimize that. Samir: observed flaky lint on windows runner in CI run 4 — asked for isolation. Maya: moved lint steps to composite actions and added retry/backoff for the rule-runner which fixed the flake. Final: approvals from Arjun and Lena after small nits fixed (action descriptions and improved artifact TTL). Merge: squash and merge after green CI.
sample_diff:
name: CI Phases
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Compute dep stamp
        uses: ./.github/actions/dep-stamp
      - name: Upload dep-stamp
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: dep-stamp
          path: dependency-stamp.txt
